var tlCur = {trip:'oct', stop:0};

function tlRender() {
  var s = tlData[tlCur.trip][tlCur.stop];
  var tags = s.tags.map(function(t) {
    return '<span class="tl-tag' + (s.mac ? ' m' : '') + '">' + t + '</span>';
  }).join('');
  document.getElementById('tl-detail').innerHTML =
    '<div class="tl-detail' + (s.mac ? ' mac' : '') + '">' +
    '<p class="tl-d-days">' + s.days + '</p> ' +
    '<p class="tl-d-title">' + s.title + '</p> ' +
    '<p class="tl-d-dist">' + s.dist + '</p> ' +
    '<p class="tl-d-text">' + s.text + '</p> ' +
    (s.wind ? '<p class="tl-d-wind">' + s.wind + '</p> ' : '') +
    '<div class="tl-tags">' + tags + '</div>' +
    '</div>';
}

function tlStop(trip, idx) {
  tlCur.stop = idx;
  document.querySelectorAll('#tl-road-' + trip + ' .tl-stop').forEach(function(el, i) {
    el.classList.toggle('act', i === idx);
  });
  tlRender();
}

function tlTrip(trip) {
  tlCur.trip = trip;
  tlCur.stop = 0;
  ['oct','nov'].forEach(function(t) {
    document.getElementById('tl-road-' + t).style.display = t === trip ? 'block' : 'none';
    document.getElementById('tl-meta-' + t).style.display = t === trip ? 'flex' : 'none';
  });
  document.getElementById('tl-btn-oct').className = 'tl-tbtn' + (trip === 'oct' ? ' act' : '');
  document.getElementById('tl-btn-nov').className = 'tl-tbtn' + (trip === 'nov' ? ' act' : '');
  document.querySelectorAll('#tl-road-' + trip + ' .tl-stop').forEach(function(el, i) {
    el.classList.toggle('act', i === 0);
  });
  tlRender();
}

tlRender();

function rmDuur(d) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.rm-p11').forEach(function(el){ el.style.display = d === '11' ? 'inline' : 'none'; });
  document.querySelectorAll('.rm-p15').forEach(function(el){ el.style.display = d === '15' ? 'inline' : 'none'; });
  document.querySelectorAll('.rm-tbtn').forEach(function(btn){ btn.classList.remove('act'); });
  document.querySelectorAll('.rm-tbtn')[d === '11' ? 0 : 1].classList.add('act');
}

<script>
function pkShow(pack) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.pk-pane').forEach(function(p){ p.classList.remove('active'); });
  document.getElementById('pk-' + pack).classList.add('active');
  document.querySelectorAll('.pk-card').forEach(function(c){ c.classList.remove('active-teal','active-pink'); });
  if(pack === 'advanced') {
    document.querySelectorAll('.pk-card.teal')[0].classList.add('active-teal');
  } else {
    document.querySelectorAll('.pk-card.pink')[0].classList.add('active-pink');
  }
}
</script></div>

jQuery(function($){
$(document).ready(function(){
 
$('#testimonial-person-1').addClass('testimonial-active');
 
$('[id*="testimonial-person"]').hover(function() {
 
var $selector = $(this).attr('id').replace('person', 'copy');

$('[id*="testimonial-copy"]').removeClass('show-testimonial');
$testimonial.addClass('show-testimonial');

});

<script>
function psShow(tab) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.ps-pane').forEach(function(p) { p.classList.remove('active'); });
  document.querySelectorAll('.ps-tab').forEach(function(t) { t.classList.remove('act'); });
  document.getElementById('ps-' + tab).classList.add('active');
  event.currentTarget.classList.add('act');
}
</script></div>

<p>Our aim is to bring the right people to the right place. To be at the right spot for the wind and maximize your time on the water.   </p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px;">We value respect &amp; kindness and ask you to treat your kite buddies and staff with that same manner. We are not a party-camp, but will host some party nights and can get you to the party if you want a bit more.</span></p>
<p>Ps. If you let us do our thing, you will get to do your thing in the best way possible 🙂<br />Pss: We host kitesurfers from all over the world. Come with an open heart and you will make kite friends for life! <em></em></p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_button_module_wrapper et_pb_button_1_wrapper et_pb_button_alignment_center et_pb_module ">
				<a class="et_pb_button et_pb_button_1 et_animated et_pb_bg_layout_dark" href="https://bookings.toowettoshred.com/en/product/kitesurf-camp-brazil" data-icon="">I&#039;m joining!</a>
			</div>
			</div>
				
				
				
				
			</div>
				
				
			</div><div id="faq" class="et_pb_section et_pb_section_11 et_pb_with_background et_section_regular" >
				
				
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_14">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_4_4 et_pb_column_25  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_25  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner">FAQ<br />
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Gagalin, Helvetica, Arial, Lucida, sans-serif; font-size: 26px;">For the kitesurf camp&nbsp;</span></div>
			</div>
			</div>
				
				
				
				
			</div><div class="et_pb_with_border et_pb_row et_pb_row_15">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_3 et_pb_column_26  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_toggle et_pb_toggle_0 et_pb_toggle_item  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_toggle_close">
				
				
				
				
				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">Can I come all by myself?</h5>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p><strong>Yes</strong> Please do! Most of our guest are &#8216;solo&#8217; travellers at the beginning of the week. You will make friends here before you know it 🙂</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_toggle et_pb_toggle_1 et_pb_toggle_item  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_toggle_close">
				
				
				
				
				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">What wetsuit do I need?</h5>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p>You won&#8217;t really need a wetsuit but if you are planning on pulling big loops &amp; stay for all the sunset sessions &#8211; a 1 mm butt protection shorty will be useful. </p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_toggle et_pb_toggle_2 et_pb_toggle_item  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_toggle_close">
				
				
				
				
				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">I have a special diet. Can I join?</h5>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p>Yes, but if you have a serious allergy, please contact us before booking. Brazil is not the easiest to travel with a special diet. We like to keep the expectations fair. </p>
<p>It is veggie friendly (not perfect, but acceptable) and lot&#8217;s of healthy choices for those that want to stay fit.</p></div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_3 et_pb_column_27  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_toggle et_pb_toggle_3 et_pb_toggle_item  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_toggle_close">
				
				
				
				
				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">Can I book private lessons?</h5>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p>Mmmm. If you need a refresher this can be arranged but we prefer you are independent already to get the most out of the experience. Maybe you can take some lessons before joining? We can help with that. </p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_toggle et_pb_toggle_4 et_pb_toggle_item  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_toggle_close">
				
				
				
				
				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">What does a typical day look like?</h5>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p>Hmmmm, it could be:</p>
<p>8 AM Breakfast<br />10 AM Yoga<br />11 AM First session before Acai<br />2 PM lunch time!<br />3 PM After lunch party on the water, are you ready?</p>
<p>7 PM Sunset drinks<br />8 PM dinner time<br />10 PM sleep / party / party in bed<br /><em><br />(Some nights everyone is so tired and just wants to sleep at 10. It&#8217;s funny what kiting does to you..)</em></p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_toggle et_pb_toggle_5 et_pb_toggle_item  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_toggle_close">
				
				
				
				
				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">My flight arrives after midnight..</h5>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p>No problem! We will arrange your airport pick up and bring you to Taiba. But you will miss out on the first group dinner.. </p>
<p>For your departure please make sure you book the right dates!</p></div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_3 et_pb_column_28  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				
				
				
				
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_toggle et_pb_toggle_6 et_pb_toggle_item  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_toggle_close">
				
				
				
				
				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">Do I bring my own gear?</h5>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p>Yes. That is the easiest &amp; most comfy for this trip. </p>
<p>If for whatever reason you cannot bring your gear or really want to travel light; please let us know well in advance and book the Advanced+rental pack.</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_toggle et_pb_toggle_7 et_pb_toggle_item  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_toggle_close">
				
				
				
				
				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">Do I bring sunscreen?</h5>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><b>Absolutely!</b></p>
<p><b> </b></p>
<p><b></b>Loads. Bring sunscreen for your face &amp; hands to keep you protected. Zinc might be good option. The more the better 😉</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_toggle et_pb_toggle_8 et_pb_toggle_item  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_toggle_close">
				
				
				
				
				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">Can I prepare myself for the sessions?</h5>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p><b>Yess!</b></p>
<p><b></b>Go get that body moving! How do you prepare for 14 days of kiting non-stop? Work that body. Strong abs will help for all the tricks you want to try. Go go!</p>
<p>Duotone has a great library of video&#8217;s (for all levels), so if you want to mentally prepare for some new tricks, have a look <a href="https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLwYlLMr01z4EmqeIMMBo0JaP8K-0qG-9R" target="_blank" rel="noopener">HERE</a> </p></div>
			</div>
			</div>
				
				
				
				
			</div>
				
				
			</div>		</div>
	</div>
